title: close --summary names each goal clause of the sprint and the item that carried it
goal: backlog.py close --summary prints the sprint's goal split into its clauses (by '; ' and ', and'), each with the done item whose goal covers it or 'unmet' and the item that now carries it, so a clause whose item was deferred mid-sprint shows at the close; a test plants a sprint whose clause item was moved out. Answers the SP-w3xmbdra retrospective: goal clause 1 (seed pack index) went unmet when ST-4mcoplex was deferred, and only the review notes said so.
